snippet.title: Mycelium: The Silent Contract - DEMO Teaser
snippet.description:
DEMO Page here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3999340/Mycelium_The_Silent_Contract_Demo/
WISHLIST full game now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3583970/Mycelium_The_Silent_Contract/

You arrive. You gather. You extract. Join an endless cycle of hunting for Mycelium in a haunted procedurally generated forest. Work alone or with up to 4 contractors, solve the mysteries, and avoid dangers. And most importantly - don't get lost!

JOIN DISCORD for more info: https://discord.gg/GTYUGCyw2h
